map.惊恐障碍严重度量表(PDSS)自评版，评估过去一周内惊恐发作的频率、痛苦及功能影: Panic Disorder Severity Scale (PDSS) self-report rates frequency, distress and functional impact of panic attacks over the past week. 7 items, 0-4 each, total 0-28. Total >=8 suggests clinically significant panic disorder.
map.PDSS惊恐障碍严重度 = Σ7个条目（每项0-4，满分28）；均值=总分÷7；: PDSS severity = sum of 7 items (0-4, max 28); mean = total / 7; <=3 subclinical, 4-7 mild, 8-13 moderate, >=14 severe.
map.本量表为自助筛查工具，不能替代精神科专业诊断。惊恐障碍一线治疗为认知行为治疗(C: This is a self-help screening tool and does not replace psychiatric diagnosis. First-line treatment for panic disorder is CBT and SSRIs.
map.📚 深度解析：PDSS 惊恐障碍严重度: 📚 Deep Dive: PDSS Panic Disorder Severity
map.7 个维度各 0–4：发作频率1、痛苦1、预期焦虑1、场所回避1、情境回避1、发: 7 dimensions each 0-4: attack frequency 1, distress 1, anticipatory anxiety 1, agoraphobia 1, situational avoidance 1, within-attack fear 2, impairment 1 -> total 8, near clinical cutoff; monitoring advised.
map.各维度 3–4 分合计 18，重度，需系统药物+心理治疗并排查共病。: Dimensions 3-4 sum 18, severe; needs systematic medication + psychotherapy and comorbidity workup.
map.常用总分 ≥8 提示需关注，≥14 多为中重度；但应结合临床晤谈而非单凭分数。: Commonly total >=8 warrants attention, >=14 mostly moderate-severe; but combine with clinical interview, not score alone.
map.PDSS 偏严重度量表，另可配合惊恐相关感知自评（如 ACQ）评估认知特征。: PDSS is severity-oriented; it can pair with panic-related cognition self-rating (e.g. ACQ) to assess cognitive features.
